source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice long questions written from Unit 9 (PDF 256-275), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh Unit 9 (Inverse Trigonometric (TOC: 'Inverse Trigonometric Functions and Their Graphs')) ke poore unit se practice long questions (tafseeli sawal) hain, Board ke Section-II ke sawal ke hisse ki shakal mein: har sawal 5 number ka hai (lamba sawal, saboot (proof) ya derivation). Har sawal poore qadmon ke saath hal kiya gaya hai.

blocks.prompt:
1 Prove that (i) \(\cos^{-1}(-x) = \pi - \cos^{-1} x\) (ii) \(\sin^{-1}(-x) = -\sin^{-1} x\), for \(-1 \le x \le 1\). Verify both for \(x = \frac{1}{2}\). (5 marks)
(Saabit karein ke (i) \(\cos^{-1}(-x) = \pi - \cos^{-1} x\) (ii) \(\sin^{-1}(-x) = -\sin^{-1} x\), jab \(-1 \le x \le 1\). Dono ki \(x = \frac{1}{2}\) par tasdeeq karein.)
blocks.explanation: Angle ka naam rakhein, cos(pi - t) = -cos t aur sin(-t) = -sin t lagayein, aur dekhein ke naya angle principal range mein hai.

book_ref.quote: A pattern you can see in the table

steps: \(-\phi\) bhi \(\left[-\frac{\pi}{2}, \frac{\pi}{2}\right]\) mein hai, is liye \(\sin^{-1}(-x) = -\sin^{-1} x\)

blocks.prompt:
2 Find the principal value of (i) \(\sin^{-1}\left(\sin\frac{5\pi}{6}\right)\) (ii) \(\cos^{-1}\left(\cos\left(-\frac{2\pi}{3}\right)\right)\) (iii) \(\tan^{-1}\left(\tan\frac{7\pi}{6}\right)\) (iv) \(\sec^{-1}\left(\sec\left(-\frac{\pi}{4}\right)\right)\). (5 marks)
(Principal value nikalein: (i) \(\sin^{-1}\left(\sin\frac{5\pi}{6}\right)\) (ii) \(\cos^{-1}\left(\cos\left(-\frac{2\pi}{3}\right)\right)\) (iii) \(\tan^{-1}\left(\tan\frac{7\pi}{6}\right)\) (iv) \(\sec^{-1}\left(\sec\left(-\frac{\pi}{4}\right)\right)\).)
blocks.explanation: Pehle andar wali value nikalein, phir principal range mein us value wala aik angle chunein (jawab hamesha diya hua angle nahin hota).

book_ref.quote: How to find a principal value (the method of Example 1)

blocks.prompt:
3 Prove that \(\cot^{-1} x = \pi + \tan^{-1}\frac{1}{x}\) for \(x < 0\). Verify it for \(x = -\frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}\). (5 marks)
(Saabit karein ke \(x < 0\) ke liye \(\cot^{-1} x = \pi + \tan^{-1}\frac{1}{x}\). \(x = -\frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}\) par tasdeeq karein.)
blocks.explanation: Manfi \(x\) par \(\cot^{-1} x\) obtuse hai, \(\tan^{-1}\) ki range se bahar; \(\pi\) ghata kar range mein laayein (tangent ka period \(\pi\)).

book_ref.quote: For negative \(x\) the correct relation is

steps: \(y - \pi\) \(\tan^{-1}\) ki range mein hai: \(y - \pi = \tan^{-1}\frac{1}{x}\), yaani \(\cot^{-1} x = \pi + \tan^{-1}\frac{1}{x}\)
blocks.final_answer: Saabit hua: \(x < 0\) ke liye \(\cot^{-1} x = \pi + \tan^{-1}\frac{1}{x}\); \(x = -\frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}\) par dono \(\frac{2\pi}{3}\).

blocks.prompt:
4 Find the domain of (i) \(f(x) = \sin^{-1}\left(\frac{x - 1}{2}\right) + \sec^{-1}(x + 1)\) (ii) \(g(x) = \cos^{-1}(x^{2} - 1)\). (5 marks)
(Domain nikalein: (i) \(f(x) = \sin^{-1}\left(\frac{x - 1}{2}\right) + \sec^{-1}(x + 1)\) (ii) \(g(x) = \cos^{-1}(x^{2} - 1)\).)
blocks.explanation: Har inverse function ka input us ki apni domain mein ho; jama mein dono shartein aik saath, is liye mushtarka hissa lein.

book_ref.quote: an inverse trigonometric function only accepts inputs from its own domain

blocks.prompt:
5 Without using a calculator find (i) \(\sin\left(\frac{1}{2}\cos^{-1}\frac{17}{25}\right)\) (ii) \(\cos\left(\frac{1}{2}\sec^{-1}\frac{9}{7}\right)\). (5 marks)
(Calculator ke baghair nikalein: (i) \(\sin\left(\frac{1}{2}\cos^{-1}\frac{17}{25}\right)\) (ii) \(\cos\left(\frac{1}{2}\sec^{-1}\frac{9}{7}\right)\).)
blocks.explanation: Andar wale angle ko \(\alpha\) kahein, \(\cos\alpha\) nikalein, aur half-angle identities lagayein (acute \(\frac{\alpha}{2}\) ke liye musbat root).

book_ref.quote: which needs only \(\cos\alpha\)

blocks.prompt:
6 Prove that \(\cos(\tan^{-1} x) = \frac{1}{\sqrt{1 + x^{2}}}\) and \(\sin(\tan^{-1} x) = \frac{x}{\sqrt{1 + x^{2}}}\) for every real \(x\). Hence find \(\cos\left(\tan^{-1}\left(-\frac{3}{4}\right)\right)\) and \(\sin\left(\tan^{-1}\left(-\frac{3}{4}\right)\right)\). (5 marks)
(Saabit karein ke har real \(x\) ke liye \(\cos(\tan^{-1} x) = \frac{1}{\sqrt{1 + x^{2}}}\) aur \(\sin(\tan^{-1} x) = \frac{x}{\sqrt{1 + x^{2}}}\). Phir \(\cos\left(\tan^{-1}\left(-\frac{3}{4}\right)\right)\) aur \(\sin\left(\tan^{-1}\left(-\frac{3}{4}\right)\right)\) nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Angle ka naam rakhein; \(1 + \tan^{2}\alpha = \sec^{2}\alpha\) se \(\cos\alpha\), nishan principal range se.

book_ref.quote: build the point \((3, 4)\) to get \(\sin\alpha\) and \(\cos\alpha\)

blocks.prompt:
7 Derive the formula \(\sin^{-1} x + \sin^{-1} y = \sin^{-1}\left(x\sqrt{1 - y^{2}} + y\sqrt{1 - x^{2}}\right)\), stating why the positive square roots are taken. Verify it for \(x = 0.3\), \(y = 0.4\). (5 marks)
(Formula \(\sin^{-1} x + \sin^{-1} y = \sin^{-1}\left(x\sqrt{1 - y^{2}} + y\sqrt{1 - x^{2}}\right)\) derive karein, aur batayein ke musbat square roots kyun liye. \(x = 0.3\), \(y = 0.4\) par tasdeeq karein.)
blocks.explanation: Do angles ke naam rakhein, un ke cosines nikalein (principal range mein manfi nahin), sin(a + b) phailayein, phir inverse sine lein.

book_ref.quote: Since \(\alpha, \beta \in \left[-\frac{\pi}{2}, \frac{\pi}{2}\right]\), so \(\cos\alpha, \cos\beta \ge 0\)

steps: Is range mein cosine manfi nahin: \(\cos\alpha = \sqrt{1 - x^{2}}\), \(\cos\beta = \sqrt{1 - y^{2}}\)
Jab \(\alpha + \beta\) \(\left[-\frac{\pi}{2}, \frac{\pi}{2}\right]\) mein ho: \(\alpha + \beta = \sin^{-1}\left(x\sqrt{1 - y^{2}} + y\sqrt{1 - x^{2}}\right)\)
blocks.final_answer: Saabit hua: \(\sin^{-1} x + \sin^{-1} y = \sin^{-1}\left(x\sqrt{1 - y^{2}} + y\sqrt{1 - x^{2}}\right)\).

blocks.prompt:
8 Prove that \(\sin^{-1} x - \sin^{-1} y = \sin^{-1}\left(x\sqrt{1 - y^{2}} - y\sqrt{1 - x^{2}}\right)\). Verify it for \(x = \frac{12}{13}\), \(y = \frac{4}{5}\). (5 marks)
(Saabit karein ke \(\sin^{-1} x - \sin^{-1} y = \sin^{-1}\left(x\sqrt{1 - y^{2}} - y\sqrt{1 - x^{2}}\right)\). \(x = \frac{12}{13}\), \(y = \frac{4}{5}\) par tasdeeq karein.)
blocks.explanation: Formula (i) jaisa aaghaz, magar sin(a - b) phailayein.

book_ref.quote: (ii) Same start as (i), but use

steps: Jab \(\alpha - \beta\) range mein ho (maslan \(xy \ge 0\)): \(\alpha - \beta = \sin^{-1}\left(x\sqrt{1 - y^{2}} - y\sqrt{1 - x^{2}}\right)\)
blocks.final_answer: Saabit hua; diye gaye values par dono taraf \(\sin^{-1}\frac{16}{65}\).

blocks.prompt:
9 Prove that \(\cos^{-1} x + \cos^{-1} y = \cos^{-1}\left(xy - \sqrt{(1 - x^{2})(1 - y^{2})}\right)\) (valid when \(x + y \ge 0\)). Verify it for \(x = y = \frac{1}{2}\). (5 marks)
(Saabit karein ke \(\cos^{-1} x + \cos^{-1} y = \cos^{-1}\left(xy - \sqrt{(1 - x^{2})(1 - y^{2})}\right)\) (jab \(x + y \ge 0\)). \(x = y = \frac{1}{2}\) par tasdeeq karein.)
blocks.explanation: Ab angles \([0, \pi]\) mein hain jahan sine manfi nahin; \(\cos(\alpha + \beta)\) minus ke nishan ke saath phailayein.

book_ref.quote: Now \(\alpha, \beta \in [0, \pi]\), so

steps: \([0, \pi]\) mein sine manfi nahin: \(\sin\alpha = \sqrt{1 - x^{2}}\), \(\sin\beta = \sqrt{1 - y^{2}}\)
blocks.final_answer: Saabit hua; \(x = y = \frac{1}{2}\) par dono taraf \(\frac{2\pi}{3}\).

blocks.prompt:
10 Prove that \(\cos^{-1} x - \cos^{-1} y = \cos^{-1}\left(xy + \sqrt{(1 - x^{2})(1 - y^{2})}\right)\) (valid when \(x \le y\)). Verify it for \(x = 0\), \(y = \frac{1}{2}\). (5 marks)
(Saabit karein ke \(\cos^{-1} x - \cos^{-1} y = \cos^{-1}\left(xy + \sqrt{(1 - x^{2})(1 - y^{2})}\right)\) (jab \(x \le y\)). \(x = 0\), \(y = \frac{1}{2}\) par tasdeeq karein.)
blocks.explanation: Formula (iii) jaisa aaghaz, magar \(\cos(\alpha - \beta)\) phailayein (plus ka nishan).

book_ref.quote: (iv) The same, with \(\cos(\alpha - \beta) = \cos\alpha\cos\beta + \sin\alpha\sin\beta\)

steps: \(x \le y\) ho to \(\alpha \ge \beta\) (\(\cos^{-1}\) ghatne wala), is liye \(0 \le \alpha - \beta \le \pi\)
blocks.final_answer: Saabit hua; diye gaye values par dono taraf \(\frac{\pi}{6}\).

blocks.prompt:
11 Prove that \(\tan^{-1} x + \tan^{-1} y = \tan^{-1}\frac{x + y}{1 - xy}\) (\(xy < 1\)). Deduce that \(2\tan^{-1} x = \tan^{-1}\frac{2x}{1 - x^{2}}\) for \(-1 < x < 1\), and use it to find \(2\tan^{-1}\frac{1}{2}\). (5 marks)
(Saabit karein ke \(\tan^{-1} x + \tan^{-1} y = \tan^{-1}\frac{x + y}{1 - xy}\) (\(xy < 1\)). Phir \(2\tan^{-1} x = \tan^{-1}\frac{2x}{1 - x^{2}}\) (\(-1 < x < 1\)) akhaz karein aur \(2\tan^{-1}\frac{1}{2}\) nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Angles ke naam rakhein, \(\tan(\alpha + \beta)\) ka formula lagayein, phir \(y = x\) rakhein.

book_ref.quote: Next, we proceed to prove formula (v) as follows

steps: \(xy < 1\) ho to \(\alpha + \beta\) range mein: \(\alpha + \beta = \tan^{-1}\frac{x + y}{1 - xy}\)

blocks.prompt:
12 Prove that \(\tan^{-1} x - \tan^{-1} y = \tan^{-1}\frac{x - y}{1 + xy}\) (\(xy > -1\)). Verify it for \(x = 1\), \(y = \frac{1}{3}\). (5 marks)
(Saabit karein ke \(\tan^{-1} x - \tan^{-1} y = \tan^{-1}\frac{x - y}{1 + xy}\) (\(xy > -1\)). \(x = 1\), \(y = \frac{1}{3}\) par tasdeeq karein.)
blocks.explanation: Formula (v) ki tarah, magar \(\tan(\alpha - \beta)\) ke saath.

book_ref.quote: For (vi) take the same \(\alpha\) and \(\beta\)

blocks.prompt:
13 Deduce \(2\sin^{-1} x = \sin^{-1}\left(2x\sqrt{1 - x^{2}}\right)\) from formula (i) and \(2\cos^{-1} x = \cos^{-1}(2x^{2} - 1)\) from formula (iii). Use them to write \(2\sin^{-1}\frac{1}{3}\) and \(2\cos^{-1}\frac{1}{3}\) as single inverse functions. (5 marks)
(Formula (i) se \(2\sin^{-1} x = \sin^{-1}\left(2x\sqrt{1 - x^{2}}\right)\) aur formula (iii) se \(2\cos^{-1} x = \cos^{-1}(2x^{2} - 1)\) akhaz karein. In se \(2\sin^{-1}\frac{1}{3}\) aur \(2\cos^{-1}\frac{1}{3}\) ko aik aik inverse function mein likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Formulas (i) aur (iii) mein y = x rakhein; natije lagane se pehle shartein dekhein.

book_ref.quote: The second result comes from (iii)

blocks.prompt:
14 Prove that \(\cos^{-1} x = \tan^{-1}\frac{\sqrt{1 - x^{2}}}{x}\) for \(0 < x \le 1\). Hence show that \(\cos^{-1}\frac{5}{13} = \tan^{-1}\frac{12}{5}\). (5 marks)
(Saabit karein ke \(0 < x \le 1\) ke liye \(\cos^{-1} x = \tan^{-1}\frac{\sqrt{1 - x^{2}}}{x}\). Phir dikhayein ke \(\cos^{-1}\frac{5}{13} = \tan^{-1}\frac{12}{5}\).)
blocks.explanation: Angle ka naam rakhein, \(\sin\alpha\) nikalein, taqseem se \(\tan\alpha\), aur dekhein ke \(\alpha\) \(\tan^{-1}\) ki range mein hai.

book_ref.quote: The same triangle idea turns any inverse function into another.

blocks.prompt:
15 Prove that \(\sin^{-1}\frac{3}{5} + \sin^{-1}\frac{8}{17} = \sin^{-1}\frac{77}{85}\). (5 marks)
(Saabit karein ke \(\sin^{-1}\frac{3}{5} + \sin^{-1}\frac{8}{17} = \sin^{-1}\frac{77}{85}\).)
blocks.explanation: Do \(\sin^{-1}\) ka jama: shart \(x^{2} + y^{2} \le 1\) dekhein, phir formula (i).

book_ref.quote: These identities can be derived by applying the fundamental trigonometric identities along with algebraic manipulation.

blocks.prompt:
16 Prove that \(\sin^{-1}\frac{4}{5} - \sin^{-1}\frac{8}{17} = \sin^{-1}\frac{36}{85}\). (5 marks)
(Saabit karein ke \(\sin^{-1}\frac{4}{5} - \sin^{-1}\frac{8}{17} = \sin^{-1}\frac{36}{85}\).)
blocks.explanation: Do \(\sin^{-1}\) ka farq, \(xy \ge 0\): formula (ii).

book_ref.quote: Similarly, we can prove (ii), (iii) and (iv).

blocks.explanation: Do \(\cos^{-1}\) ka jama, \(x + y \ge 0\): formula (iii), minus ke saath.

book_ref.quote: Then \(\cos(\alpha + \beta) = \cos\alpha\cos\beta - \sin\alpha\sin\beta = xy - \sqrt{(1-x^{2})(1-y^{2})}\)

blocks.prompt:
18 Prove that \(\cos^{-1}\frac{5}{13} - \cos^{-1}\frac{4}{5} = \cos^{-1}\frac{56}{65}\). (5 marks)
(Saabit karein ke \(\cos^{-1}\frac{5}{13} - \cos^{-1}\frac{4}{5} = \cos^{-1}\frac{56}{65}\).)
blocks.explanation: Do \(\cos^{-1}\) ka farq, \(x \le y\): formula (iv), plus ke saath.

book_ref.quote: For \(\cos^{-1}\) the angle is in \([0, \pi]\), so there it is the sine that is never negative.

blocks.prompt:
19 Prove that \(\sin^{-1}\frac{5}{13} + \tan^{-1}\frac{3}{4} = \tan^{-1}\frac{56}{33}\). (5 marks)
(Saabit karein ke \(\sin^{-1}\frac{5}{13} + \tan^{-1}\frac{3}{4} = \tan^{-1}\frac{56}{33}\).)
blocks.explanation: Pehle \(\sin^{-1}\frac{5}{13}\) ko \(\tan^{-1}\) mein badlein (tikon 5, 12, 13), phir formula (v) se jorein.

book_ref.quote: Exercise 9.2 needs when the answer is in a different inverse function from the question

blocks.prompt:
20 Prove that \(\tan^{-1}\frac{1}{2} + \tan^{-1}\frac{1}{5} + \tan^{-1}\frac{1}{8} = \frac{\pi}{4}\). (5 marks)
(Saabit karein ke \(\tan^{-1}\frac{1}{2} + \tan^{-1}\frac{1}{5} + \tan^{-1}\frac{1}{8} = \frac{\pi}{4}\).)
blocks.explanation: Formula (v) se do do terms jorein, har dafa xy < 1 dekhein.

book_ref.quote: They join two inverse functions into one.

blocks.prompt:
21 Prove that \(4\tan^{-1}\frac{1}{5} - \tan^{-1}\frac{1}{239} = \frac{\pi}{4}\). (5 marks)
(Saabit karein ke \(4\tan^{-1}\frac{1}{5} - \tan^{-1}\frac{1}{239} = \frac{\pi}{4}\).)
blocks.explanation: Do dafa double formula lagayein (har dafa \(|x| < 1\)), phir formula (vi) se tafreeq.

book_ref.quote: Double results: \(2\tan^{-1}x = \tan^{-1}\frac{2x}{1-x^{2}}\)

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Yahan sab se zaroori baat shart (condition) hai: double formula sirf \(|x| < 1\) par chalta hai. Pehli dafa \(x = \frac{1}{5}\), doosri dafa \(x = \frac{5}{12}\); dono 1 se chhote hain, is liye dono qadam sahi hain. Aakhri fraction mein \(119 \cdot 239\) se oopar aur neeche zarb dene se bari fraction saaf ho jati hai: \(28561 = 13^{4}\) dono taraf aata hai.

blocks.prompt:
22 Solve the equation \(\tan^{-1} 2x + \tan^{-1} 3x = \frac{\pi}{4}\). (5 marks)
(Equation \(\tan^{-1} 2x + \tan^{-1} 3x = \frac{\pi}{4}\) ko hal karein.)
blocks.explanation: Formula (v) se dono angles jorein, dono taraf tan lein, quadratic hal karein, phir har root asal equation mein check karein.

book_ref.quote: In equations, test every root in the original equation

blocks.prompt:
23 Solve the equation \(\tan^{-1}(x + 1) + \tan^{-1}(x - 1) = \tan^{-1}\frac{8}{31}\). (5 marks)
(Equation \(\tan^{-1}(x + 1) + \tan^{-1}(x - 1) = \tan^{-1}\frac{8}{31}\) ko hal karein.)
blocks.explanation: Bayen taraf formula (v) se jorein, fractions barabar karein, quadratic hal karein aur dono roots check karein.

book_ref.quote: always substitute every root back into the original equation

steps: \(x = -8\): bayen taraf manfi, dayen musbat (\(ab = 63 > 1\)). Radd

blocks.prompt:
24 Without using a calculator find (i) \(\sin\left(\sin^{-1}\frac{3}{5} + \cos^{-1}\frac{5}{13}\right)\) (ii) \(\cos\left(\sin^{-1}\frac{3}{5} + \cos^{-1}\frac{5}{13}\right)\). (5 marks)
(Calculator ke baghair nikalein: (i) \(\sin\left(\sin^{-1}\frac{3}{5} + \cos^{-1}\frac{5}{13}\right)\) (ii) \(\cos\left(\sin^{-1}\frac{3}{5} + \cos^{-1}\frac{5}{13}\right)\).)
blocks.explanation: Dono angles ke naam rakhein, har aik ka sine aur cosine nikalein (dono acute), phir \(\sin(\alpha + \beta)\), \(\cos(\alpha + \beta)\) ke formulas.
